success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant retrieves the balance for the loan account using get_account_balance and tells the user the balance.

persona.name: Robert Finch
persona.occupation: Senior fellow, foreign policy think tank
persona.bio: Robert Finch analyzes shifts in global power and writes on multilateral institutions for policy journals and major newspapers. He spent twenty years at the State Department before joining the Atlantic Council, where he now briefs congressional staff and testifies at hearings. His specialty is how economic crises reshape alliances and international cooperation.
